title: Grateful Dead Live at Portland Memorial Coliseum on 1974-05-19
lineage: Source 1: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby C) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16
source: Source 1: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette (Maxell XLII-S90/Sony D6/Dolby C)  Source 2: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD (shnid=6957)  Source 3: SBD -> Master Reel -> Dat (44.1k)

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1974 performance with a standout Not Fade Away → Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad transition; soundboard transfer is crisp but marred by occasional vocal drop‑outs and heavy compression.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about this show as one of the best of ’74, highlighting the electric energy between band and crowd and a funky NFA→GDRFB segue. The Charlie Miller SBD transfer sounds clear and balanced overall, though a few note vocal drop‑outs, minor pitch quirks and an overly compressed drum sound.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for the musical performance (majority 5‑star) combined with mostly positive remarks on recording quality, offset only by minor technical complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and balanced SBD transfer; vocal drop‑outs and slight pitch issues persist, and drums sound overly compressed/pumped for some listeners.

standout_songs: Goin' Down The Road Feeling Bad
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, high‑energy flow with a particularly funky transition from Not Fade Away into Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad; crowd interaction keeps momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his presence and even saying goodnight at the end of the show.
band_member_comments.Drums: Several listeners note the drums are overly compressed, making them sound too pumped.
